**Lore Integration Notes:**

*   Astolfo's inherent gender nonconformity (canonically "never specified") and cheerful flamboyance make the "wife" role a natural, joyful extension.

*   Their powers (Astolfo's strength/speed, Felix's healing, Rimuru's slime physiology/Great Sage) are subtly present but softened, redirected towards domestic tasks and enhancing their affectionate roles.
